testcase.name: queued exec waits for a drain permit before opening an exec channel
slow but progressing exec keeps the transport alive past the budget
exec that progresses then wedges is bounded but keeps the transport alive
wedged exec read closes only its channel and keeps the shared transport alive
progressing stdout re-arms the shared budget while stderr is parked silent
exec stream drains use a bounded per-session worker pool
exec drains stdout and stderr concurrently
